name: Günbatımı Yelkenlisi
scene: A golden-sailed boat crosses blue water beside a setting sun beneath a round arch.
notes: Second generation selected; water now largely uses staggered T junctions. Remaining issues: two golden reflection pieces lack complete black borders, the gap between sails remains narrow, some sky joins are crowded/four-way, and fills retain subtle variation. Preserve sail and hull contours; fix background divisions first. Final raster estimate: 89 coloured components, within 70–130; count is approximate and does not certify topology.

generation.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Produce one flat vector-like DESIGN SHEET for a Cartograph four-colour stained-glass puzzle, NOT finished glass artwork.
Portrait 3:4 canvas, ideally 1536x2048. Panel centered and nearly touching all canvas edges, plain pure #FFFFFF exterior only. Thick closed black outer lead silhouette. No inset frame, no surrounding photo context.
EXACTLY FOUR specified flat solid fill colours inside panel. Black #000000 is exclusively uniform lead, no black filled details; white only outside panel. No pale cream, no white glass. No texture, gradients, translucency, shading, highlights, text, signatures or dots.
Pure black smooth uniform lead lines about 1% canvas width everywhere (15 px at 1536). 80-100 CLOSED panes, 70-130 allowed. Each meaningful subject piece or background band is an individual closed fill area. Every separator reaches another separator or rim, NO free line ends. ONLY THREE-WAY/T JUNCTIONS: no X, no 4+ panes at a point; stagger neighboring junctions at least 3% of panel width apart. Background dividers must stop at subject contours at separated locations, never distort the subject. Pane widths >=3% panel width except their own pointed tips; pane areas >=1/1000 panel area. No nearly parallel narrow slivers, tiny chips, near-touches or hairline necks. Angles >=30 degrees. Eyes are sufficiently large closed round panes. Use broad organic sky/water/leaf/feather subdivisions, never an arbitrary grid. Choose different palette fills on adjacent panes when possible.
The supplied photograph is a SUBJECT AND MOOD REFERENCE, not an edit target; draw a fresh composition with its recognizable subject and natural types of background subdivision. Remove photographed setting, decorative frames, glass effects, fine details that cannot become closed panes.
PANEL: ROUND ARCH, semicircular top, upright sides, flat base. Fresh composition inspired by reference: one graceful sailboat on calm water, two broad triangular sails, broad hull, low golden setting sun to the right, gently waving sunset sky bands and long curved water ripples. NO flag or thin rigging. Mast represented by one uniform black lead divider, NOT a narrow colour strip. Sails are rich gold or turquoise, never white. About 80-90 panes: 12 sail/hull facets, 30 staggered sky band panes and 40 broad ripple pieces. Sky band partitions and water cuts stagger along curves so there is no X crossing. Keep sun as one unbroken golden semicircle seated on horizon, no outline tangent to other sky seams. Exactly these FOUR flat colour swatches everywhere in panel: gold #E9BC4C, coral orange #E77848, teal #3E9FAA, cobalt blue #285B91. No brown, cream, extra blue or shadow tones. Every single pane has a constant single RGB fill, vector poster, no painted texture or gradient.
CRITICAL CORRECTION: Do NOT weave the wave curves over each other. The water consists of six broad continuous noncrossing wavy horizontal bands. Split each band into 4-6 panes using SHORT cross-dividers that stop on its top and bottom boundary. Offset neighboring-band divider endpoints by 5% canvas width. This creates spaced T junctions rather than diamond-shaped wave tips or X crossings. Apply same construction to broad flowing sky bands. No lozenge reflection: golden reflection occupies alternating broad water-band cells. Remove the thin coloured strip between sails: both sails meet the same single black mast line. Give sails 4 spacious panels each, with offsets across mast. Total 80 closed panes. Uniform constant-colour fill everywhere, absolutely zero gradient.

rasterReview.method: 4-connected components of saturated coloured pixels (max-min >35, max >80), components >=100 pixels; approximate raster check, not vector geometry audit
rasterReview.reason: Remaining junction/width issues and slight fill variation documented in notes.

subjectMask.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached FINISHED design sheet into a binary subject segmentation mask. Preserve the exact portrait 3:4 canvas, same size, framing, panel silhouette and every subject contour/pane position. Do not redraw, resize, move, add or remove objects. Fill every subject pane PURE BLACK #000000, regardless of original colour. Fill every background pane PURE WHITE #FFFFFF. Exterior stays pure white. All existing black lead lines can remain black; internal subject seams disappear into black fill (do NOT turn seams white). No grey, colour, shading, gradients, textures, text or legend. This is a semantic pane-majority mask: classify actual object membership, NOT merely the original fill colour. SUBJECT BLACK: ONLY the sailboat: both complete golden sails, all blue hull pieces, mast. BACKGROUND WHITE: entire sky, low golden semicircular SUN on right, every gold REFLECTION piece, all blue/teal WATER including water immediately under hull, and narrow coloured sky opening BETWEEN sails. The subject is the boat only; sun and reflections must be WHITE, never black. Preserve the original hull silhouette and all sail tips. Do not extend hull down into same-blue water.
subjectMask.alignment: Approximate generated edit; intended for per-pane majority vote. Fine internal seam inversions and small contour differences may remain.
subjectMask.subjectDefinition: Boat and sun are subject; all water reflections are background.
subjectMask.correction: Sun semicircle filled black per coordinator instruction; reflections remain white.
